result.topic_en: Scratch calculations on residues of Gaussian integers modulo 3+2i (norm 13), including a table of powers of 1+i reduced mod 3+2i, the reduction condition for x+yi via multiplication by 3−2i, residue classes, and a lattice-square diagram, with unrelated notes (Mattausch, Neue Damm Str., 35 Grad).

methods.what: Reduction of a Gaussian integer modulo 3+2i: multiply by the conjugate 3−2i and require the coordinates to lie between 0 and 13
Table of successive powers of 1+i reduced modulo 3+2i, showing period 12 (1+i is a primitive root mod 3+2i)
Powers of 2 (and of 6) modulo 13 listed as a power/index table
Division of nonzero residues into four classes (biquadratic character classes) modulo 3+2i
Grouping of residues 1..12 mod 13 into triples (cosets of cubic residues)
